answer: Vote weight shrinks 10% each epoch unless refilled with thread, and every refill must be signed by the ridge chip hosting that seat, whose key is certified at fabrication. The glacier counts seats per ridge, and the k-th seat on one ridge pays k thread per refill. An honest agent on its own ridge pays 1 thread per epoch. An operator packing 20 clones onto one ridge pays 210 thread every epoch, forever. Spreading them out means buying 20 physical ridge chips at full hardware price.
